name: Sparse Voxel Adjacency via Packed Keys
definition: An algorithm to compute the undirected adjacency graph of a sparse voxel cloud by converting 3D coordinates into packed integer keys, then finding neighbors using constant additive deltas on these keys, avoiding KD-trees or dense neighbor blocks.
summary: Sparse Voxel Adjacency via Packed Keys constructs voxel adjacency graphs using packed integer keys and binary search, scaling with voxel count rather than bounding box volume.
